author: GamingBolt
description:
While Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve is far from a simulationist approach to jet fighting, the title certainly has its fair share of depth hidden underneath what would otherwise appear to be arcade-y gameplay. 

To help you get a better handle on truly earning the title of ace, here are 15 tips and tricks to keep in mind when going through the campaign of Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve.
title: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve - 15 Beginners Tips And Tricks You Need To Know

author: GamingBolt
description:
So you've completed Remedy Entertainment's Control Resonant, dipping your toes in its paranatural lake that's totally an ocean and saved Manhattan from the [REDACTED]. What's left, besides speculating about the potential sequel and/or DLC? Well, a lot. Manhattan offers numerous side activities, some obvious and others far less so, and several aren't even possible until you've unlocked all the zones and every traversal ability.

Aside from collectibles, documents and recordings, there's a lot to discover in the city.
title: Control Resonant - 15 Things To Do AFTER FINISHING THE GAME

author: GamingBolt
description:
The Witcher 3 Remastered is definitely a worthy upgrade to a beloved classic, and is sure to draw in many more budding Witchers to The Continent when it drops later in the week. Of course, your first few hours on The Path can feel quite punishing if you’re still coming to terms with a frankly overwhelming number of systems and mechanics.

Well, we’re here to ease that burden and have Geralt and Roach making the most out of the adventure that accompanies the search for Ciri. 

Stick with us and The Wild Hunt is going to regret tangling with your take on Geralt once you’re done, your ability to adapt to the situation overcoming the sheer terror and magical might they bring to the fight.
title: The Witcher 3 Remastered - 15 Things I Wish I Knew Before Starting The Game
